entity.firm: Property Tax Partners is the UK's specialist accountancy firm for landlords, property investors, commercial property owners and property SPVs. We handle incorporation and structuring, Section 24, SDLT, capital gains tax, Making Tax Digital for landlords and non-resident landlord compliance, alongside rental accounts, company accounts and tax returns. Property Tax Partners is a trading name of Ashfield Trading Ltd, company number 16358723, registered office 20 Ashfield Avenue, Shipley, Bradford, BD18 3AL.
entity.serves: We act for UK landlords, property investors, commercial property owners and property SPVs, from a single buy to let held in your own name to a portfolio run through a limited company.
entity.where: We act for clients across the United Kingdom and work remotely, by phone, video and email.
howItWorks: You tell us your situation through the enquiry form: what you own, how it is held and what you need looked at.
One of our accountants calls you to go through it and answer the immediate questions.
We agree the scope and a fixed fee in writing before any work starts.
We do the work, deal with HMRC and Companies House on your behalf, and keep you ahead of your deadlines.
entity.next: We reply within 24 hours and one of our accountants comes back to you directly.
